title: DropSecure
description: Confirm before you drop! Gui + Regions & worlds SUPPORT!
body:
# DropSecure

##  Tired of accidentally tossing your best gear?

DropSecure keeps your valuable items safe by **asking you before you drop them**. Perfect for **survival servers** where every diamond counts! Especially useful on **SkyBlock servers**, where losing rare items can be a big setback!

![usage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9e3d6a5c71e453f2da25f013a6a4774f679e8ea5.gif)

## **✨ features**
**Double-Confirm Drops** → Protect players from accidental item losses.
**GUI Menu for Block Management** → Admins can add/remove blocks, players can view the list
**Material & ItemMeta Suppor**t → Control drops for specific items or whole materials.
**Per-World Rules** → Choose where DropSecure is active.
**WorldGuard Regions** → Enable/disable in specific regions for maximum flexibility.
**Fully Customizable Messages **→ Customize messages to fit your server.
**Permissions** → Allow players to toggle protection for themselves.

## **⚙️ Commands**
**/dropsecure toggle** — Toggle drop protection on or off for yourself.
**/dropsecure reload** — Reload the plugin configuration (staff only).
**/dropsecure men**u — Open the DropSecure settings menu

## **➕ Menu**

![adding item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1394bb502bb48df0224481587c6264ee0a88ff5b.gif)

Player menu:

![Player menu GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0fb5ee886e2b4adf685945172646dee6deaf8a86.png)

## **Permissions**
**dropsecure.staff** → Allows staff to access and edit DropSecure settings.
**dropsecure.toggle** → Allows players to toggle drop protection on or off for themselves.

✅ Tested On: Minecraft 1.20+ (Paper recommended, Spigot)
⚠️ This plugin is currently in BETA. Please report any bugs or issues to help improve it! ⚠️
